variants.label: A · EDITORIAL
variants.style: Bold flat editorial illustration. Confident hand-drawn forest-green contours, strong flat colour blocks, expressive natural faces and relaxed gestures. Keep this visibly two-dimensional; no 3D.

Preserve the recognisable joyful curly-haired adult woman and the cultural themes from the reference. Six subjects, in reading order: top left LA CULTURETA, the woman enjoying cultural events with tickets and music/cinema/art motifs; top middle EN FAMILIA, a parent and child enjoying a creative weekend; top right MÚSICA, the woman enjoying live music; bottom left CINE, the woman enjoying a film with popcorn; bottom middle ARTE E IDEAS, the woman exploring art and books; bottom right A ESCENA, the woman enjoying theatre and dance. Make every illustration larger and more carefully finished than the reference thumbnail. Use a coherent dark forest green, coral and warm yellow palette on a clean soft cream background. Simple event motifs and recognisable silhouettes. Clear, aligned clean gutters and equal sized illustration cells; no visible table borders. Put 'A · EDITORIAL' as one small tasteful overall title.
